body.says: One session of work with the author: when it ran, what it stood beside, the words it received in order, and the paths of evolution it noted.

beside.says: What ran beside it, as the arity of sessions grows: a note in words until that session is a holon to point at.

condensations.says: What stands for its utterances in fewer words, held as its own.

ended.says: How its end was declared, where it was declared: a session is ended by being said to end.

forkedAt.says: The utterance of that session at which it was forked.

forkedFrom.says: For a session forked from another: the session it was forked from.

kept.says: How much of it was kept, where not all of it was.

notes.says: Holons it wrote that stand on their own and that it points at, such as a licence reading.

paths.says: Paths of evolution the session noted, in the order noted.

said.says: The author's utterances, in the order they came.

sent.says: The messages it sent to other sessions, where their timelines meet: held as its own.

sources.says: The sources it read from outside the field, held as its own.

voice.says: The voice it answered in, held as its own.

body.says: One expression, of the author's or of whoever its voice says, as one message: a stretch of time in which his words bounce off each other more than off the same words elsewhere. Its parts are paragraphs and breaks, in order.

as.says: How it came: typed or spoken.

flow.says: Its paragraphs and breaks, in order.

body.says: One point, as the rule has it, held as its sentences rather than one string: a proposal beyond the drafted Paragraph, which holds text.

A mark the author drew between parts of one utterance, as ---- or **: not a divider but landscape, making space between what it parts, or by its absence clustering what it leaves together. Words across a mark stand further apart than words in one cluster. Kept exactly as drawn, since its length and kind may carry meaning; a part of the drafted types of prose to be confirmed.
One sentence, held as its words in order, so the words near each other are found near each other.

typedOrder.says: How the words came when not in the order meant, as reversed.

words.says: Its words, in the order meant, and the inline holons among them: links, emphasis, strong, code.

body.says: One word where it was said, a proposal beside the drafted Term, which is to be settled with it: its place is its locality, the sentence, paragraph and utterance holding it. What it shares with the same word elsewhere is its lexeme, which it only points at.

after.says: Marks standing after the word, as a comma or full stop.

before.says: Marks standing before the word, as an opening quote or bracket.

lexeme.says: The word as one across every place it is said.

text.says: The word meant, without the marks around it; a run of marks alone is a word of its own.

typed.says: The word as typed or heard, where it differs from what was meant.

body.says: A word as one, across every place it is said: the far relation, where the sentence is the near one. Its occurrences point at it; it holds none of them.
A possible evolution of glass, noted before it is weighed: what it opens, what unsettled decisions it rests on, and where it stands.

from.says: The utterances it was said in.

restsOn.says: The decisions not yet settled that it leans on: notes in words until those decisions are holons to point at.

stands.says: noted, weighed, chosen or let go.

body.says: Lines drawn with characters, as the author draws them: kept whole and exactly, line by line, since their meaning is their shape and not their words.

lines.says: The lines, in order, each as drawn.

body.says: The whole that holds every lexeme, so the words as one stand in one place and not each at the field's top.
A work from outside the field, read in whole: what it is, where it came from, under what licence, and its sections in order.

licence.says: The licence it is held under.

body.says: A section of a document, by its own number and title, holding its flow and then its subsections, in order: the holarchy the authors drew.

flow.says: Its paragraphs and figures, in order.

number.says: Its number as printed, empty for the abstract.

body.says: A figure or table of a document, held by its caption alone; its image is not read in.
One paragraph, held as its sentences; as read from a two-column page, so a break may fall where the authors had none.
One sentence, held as its words in order.
One word where it stands; it points at its lexeme, the word as one.

text.says: The word, without the marks around it.

body.says: A word as one, across every place it stands.
The whole holding every lexeme of this branch.
A branch over a held space: one isolated reading, its own holarchy of understandings, a store of its own beside the base. It does not record what steered it.

model.says: The model that read: a variable of the matrix, held fixed by none.

reads.says: The document whose held space it is drawn over.

seedFrom.says: Whether the seed it began from and then forgot came from inside the held space or outside it; the seed itself is not kept.

understandings.says: Every understanding it draws, top included.

body.says: One understanding in a branch, the rule's way: the biggest first, each breaking down into smaller ones, the smallest holding the base.

matters.says: What matters at its level: the variable that governs this height of the held space.

parts.says: What stands beneath it: understandings, and paragraphs or figures of the base.

prose.says: The understanding, in the reader's own words.

body.says: A statistic over the field, declared as functional data: prose and an expression, drawn whenever looked at, so it is always of the store as it stands and nothing derived goes stale.

drawn.says: How it is best looked at: a number, a table by kind, a matrix, a landscape by height.

gives.says: The expression that gives it, evaluated over the store wherever it is drawn; its result is never kept.

says.says: What it measures and why, in prose: the statistic is its prose as much as its expression.

status.says: proposed, until the functions it calls are built.

body.says: A function, as field/types/function.json declares it, carried here until the field's own is brought in; the two are one type to be merged by id when it does.

from.says: Where the holon was born from, as a path in the files it arrived from.

gives.says: For a function of one's own, the expression it gives, each argument it was given named as { arg: i }.

native.says: For one of glass's own, the name the engine evaluates it by.

says.says: What it gathers, in a sentence.

takes.says: What it is given, each in turn: a set, any number of sets, words, a store's key, or an axis to group by; nothing unless it says.

body.says: Words sent from one session to another: a point where the sessions converge, pointed at by both and held by the one that sent it.

from.says: The session it was sent from.

to.says: The session it was sent to.

body.says: A source read from outside the field: kept by its link and what was found in it, never by a copy of it.

found.says: What was found in it, each a figure or a fact as the source gave it, not checked beyond it.

link.says: Where it was read, as an address on the web: a route, not a reference.

upon.says: What stands upon it, held as its own: what it claims, what is permitted of it, a following of it, the voice read from it.

body.says: One thing a source says, as a holon of its own: what it is about, the figure and its unit, the moment it was true for, and the source that says it. Two sources saying different things of the same are two claims, and both stand.

about.says: What the claim is of, in words.

asOf.says: The moment it was true for, as the source gives it.

says.says: The claim in prose, as the source gave it.

body.says: The line of hygiene as data: for a source, what may enter the field, what may be drawn from it at reading, and what may be shared onward. The engine is to judge acts against it, as it judges every act against what the field declares.

because.says: What grants it: a licence, the author's word, a platform's terms, or the law's exceptions.

draw.says: What may be drawn from the source at the moment of reading.

enter.says: What may be held in one's own field.

of.says: The source or work it rules.

share.says: What may be shared onward, and on what terms.

body.says: Who speaks: an author, a session, a fork, a writer read from outside. An utterance says its voice by pointing at one.

of.says: The holon it is the voice of, where there is one: a session, a source.

body.says: A field following a source: at what pace, through which relay if any, and for how long. A poll is a run of it, and a poll that finds something new becomes one commit.

into.says: The store its entries are committed into.

lifetime.says: When the following ends, decided at its start.

pace.says: How often it is asked, as the follower chooses.

through.says: The relay it is followed through, if one.

body.says: A holon that stands for another in fewer words: not a version of it, since a version is the same holon changed, but a holon of its own pointing at what it condenses. Where the fuller original was never kept, it says so.

condenses.says: The fuller original, where it is kept.

of.says: In words, what it condenses, where the original is not a holon.

body.says: A piece of knowledge under the rule, one understanding, each part standing on those before it: its flow, then its sections. A brief mounted in the flow of another is a break, as starting a new file was, and that placing is the deliberate act. Exports to markdown from its depth and order while it nests no more than a heading can.

parts.says: Its sections, the briefs read through after its flow, in order, each with its name as a heading at its depth. Nothing follows them, as nothing can follow a heading and not belong to it.

path.says: The file it was unpacked from, for the brief a file is.

prose.says: Its flow, in any order: mounts of anything, a paragraph, a list, code, a statistic, a brief. Each reference says for itself whether it holds or points. What stands here is drawn as itself, so a brief shows its face.

body.says: A list of items, ordered or not, as written.
One item of a list: its marker as written, its sentences, and a list nested beneath it.
A passage set apart as a quote, holding blocks of its own.
Code as written in a fence: a string, closed, with its language.
A table, kept closed as its lines for now: opening its rows and cells into holons is left for when it is attuned to.
Prose kept closed as one string, where unpacking it would not give it back exactly: the closed form, to be opened when attuned to.
Words that lead somewhere: they hold their words and name where they lead, as written.

image.says: Whether it shows an image rather than leading to it.

leads.says: The brief it leads to, as a reference it only points by: a mention. A brief placed as a part is mounted in the flow itself, with no link.

to.says: Where it leads, where that is outside the field: an address elsewhere, as written.

body.says: Words set in emphasis. Its words, or its sentences where it holds more than one, as a ground line does.

sentences.says: Its sentences, where it holds more than one.

words.says: Its words, where it is one sentence or less.

body.says: Words set strong. Its words, or its sentences where it holds more than one, as a ground line does.

sentences.says: Its sentences, where it holds more than one.

words.says: Its words, where it is one sentence or less.

body.says: A few words of code within a sentence, a string, closed.

Markdown's form of one holon of prose: the marks, numbers, routes and whitespace by which it is written as markdown and nothing else needs. It rests on the holon and points at it, in a branch of its own, so native prose stands clean and the files come back exactly. Since breaks became direct references, the forms no longer bring the files back to the byte; a brief exports from its depth and order instead.

above.says: Whitespace above the heading of the brief a file is, where not one blank line.

front.says: The file's frontmatter, as pairs in order, for the brief a file is.

gap.says: The whitespace after the holon, where it is not the usual one: a single space between, nothing at the end; a blank line between blocks.

lead.says: Whitespace between the heading and its prose, where not one blank line.

level.says: How deep a brief's heading stands, as markdown's number of #; the brief's depth in its whole gives the same.

marker.says: Its marker with the space after it, as - or 1. written.

number.says: A brief's number as written before its title; its place in its whole's parts gives it for reading.

on.says: The holon this is markdown's form of; it points, holding nothing.

title.says: Its title, as written after the address.

to.says: A link's route as written, where the link also leads by reference.

trail.says: Whitespace after its prose, before what follows, where not the usual.

body.says: The whole holding markdown's forms of a branch of prose.

A piece of work glass takes, as data: where it stands, when, what it comes after, and the commits that carried it. Its story is the prose of the brief it also is; a step is a brief's second type, so nothing it tells is told twice.

after.says: The step it comes after, the one done before it.

commits.says: The store's commits that carried it, by name: a commit is the store's own and no holon, so it is named, not referenced.

in.says: Where the work was done or is kept: a session, a store, a brief.

on.says: When it was done or begun, as its story gives it: a day, or a span of days.

status.says: Where it stands: done, under way, waiting, or let go.

body.says: The whole holding the measures given to what was said and to briefs the work has overtaken, so they stand in one place and not each at the field's top.

measures.says: The measures, in the order they were given.

body.says: The whole holding the threads raised from what was said, so they stand in one place and not each at the field's top.

threads.says: The threads, in the order they were raised, oldest last.

body.says: The grade given to something said. The author's practice, which he calls using measures: when something is said it is given a measure, such as that it is not yet owned by the build structure, and a value, and graded, so that what matters is not forgotten and its words stay as they were said. A measure need not be concluded: it is there to reason with, so that a session can say what is to be read and what is not. A brief may be measured too, as stale: the work has overtaken it, and it is marked rather than rewritten, so that no one is fooled by it.

as.says: What it is measured by: marked, as a reader marks a book; complementary, adding to what the briefs hold; verbatim; or stale, a brief the work has overtaken, its note saying what no longer holds and what still does.

note.says: Why it was marked, in a few words: a note in the margin, written with curiosity rather than as one who knows what is good.

of.says: What was said that is measured: a whole, as a session, an utterance, a paragraph or a sentence; with a range, the whole the run lies within. Or a brief, where it is measured stale.

owned.says: The brief that already holds what was said, where the structure owns it; unsaid where nothing built owns it yet.

range.says: Where the mark falls on a run of the whole's parts rather than the whole: from the first part to the last, in the whole's order.

thread.says: The thread that takes it in, where one does.

value.says: Its grade: 3 not to be forgotten, 2 steers what is built, 1 noted. A scale for now, the author's to change. For stale: 3 would mislead whoever builds on it, 2 a part overtaken, 1 a detail.

body.says: A matter raised in what was said and not yet owned by what is built: what it asks, where the author left it, the sentences it was raised in, and the briefs it bears on. The author's own words stay its ground, pointed at and never retold as settled; held as a holon because that is the respectful way to hold another's words.

asks.says: What it holds open, or what was said that steers, in the session's words.

raised.says: The author's sentences it was raised in, as they were said.

stands.says: open, leaning, settled or let go: as the author left it, not as a brief made it.

touches.says: The briefs it bears on, where one says more or less than the author did.

body.says: The whole holding the sessions, so they stand in one place and not each at the field's top.

sessions.says: The sessions, in the order they began.

body.says: The whole holding the statistics and functions declared over the field and not yet built, so they stand in one place and not each at the field's top.
A work's licence as read: what it says, who decided the reading, and the permission it grants.

decided.says: Who read it so, and when.

licence.says: The licence, by name and address.

permission.says: The permission it grants, held as its own.

says.says: What it comes to, each a sentence.

work.says: The work it governs, as cited.
